x68000:157680.text: RPG Ring Master kedua: setelah negara kecil Filias Nogis ditaklukkan, para pahlawannya terus berjuang.

x68000:157681.en: Hobby Japan's role-playing game: the small country of Filias Nogis faces invasion after a long peace.
x68000:157681.text: RPG dari Hobby Japan: negara kecil Filias Nogis menghadapi invasi setelah perdamaian yang panjang.

x68000:157682.en: An adventure about a young woman named Saori and the strange events on her way home.
x68000:157682.text: Petualangan tentang seorang wanita muda bernama Saori dan peristiwa aneh dalam perjalanan pulangnya.

x68000:157683.en: Mahjong solitaire: remove pairs of matching tiles from a stacked layout, taking only tiles free on one side.
x68000:157683.text: Solitaire mahjong: hapus pasangan ubin yang sama dari susunan bertumpuk, hanya mengambil ubin yang bebas di satu sisi.

x68000:157684.en: Mahjong solitaire with a dozen tile layouts, from the classic Dragon to new shapes.
x68000:157684.text: Solitaire mahjong dengan selusin tata letak ubin, dari Dragon klasik hingga bentuk-bentuk baru.

x68000:157685.en: A turn-based fantasy strategy game: a young man and his girlfriend are pulled into a magical kingdom at war.
x68000:157685.text: Game strategi fantasi berbasis giliran: seorang pemuda dan kekasihnya terseret ke kerajaan sihir yang sedang berperang.

x68000:157686.en: The second Shangrlia strategy game: dark forces threaten the magical kingdom again.
x68000:157686.text: Game strategi Shangrlia kedua: kekuatan gelap kembali mengancam kerajaan sihir.

x68000:157694.en: An adventure based on the manga Silent Möbius: the police unit AMP investigates a supernatural case in a future Tokyo.
x68000:157694.text: Petualangan berdasarkan manga Silent Möbius: unit polisi AMP menyelidiki kasus supernatural di Tokyo masa depan.

x68000:157695.en: Run an ant colony: control a single ant to forage, dig and recruit, and expand the nest to drive out rival red ants and the house's owners.
x68000:157695.text: Kelola koloni semut: kendalikan satu semut untuk mencari makan, menggali, dan merekrut, serta perluas sarang untuk mengusir semut merah saingan dan pemilik rumah.

x68000:157696.en: Maxis's city builder: zone land, build roads, power and services, balance taxes and budgets, and deal with disasters as the city grows.
x68000:157696.text: Game pembangun kota dari Maxis: tentukan zona tanah, bangun jalan, listrik, dan layanan, seimbangkan pajak dan anggaran, dan hadapi bencana seiring kota tumbuh.

x68000:157697.en: Guide a planet through billions of years: shape its geology, atmosphere and life, nurturing species toward intelligence and civilization.
x68000:157697.text: Pandu sebuah planet melalui miliaran tahun: bentuk geologi, atmosfer, dan kehidupannya, pelihara spesies menuju kecerdasan dan peradaban.

x68000:157698.en: A vertical shooter in a biplane: fly over World War II battlefields, destroying tanks, ships and planes with upgradable guns and bombs.
x68000:157698.text: Penembak vertikal dengan pesawat sayap ganda: terbang di atas medan perang Perang Dunia II, menghancurkan tank, kapal, dan pesawat dengan senapan dan bom yang dapat ditingkatkan.

x68000:157699.en: A simple doujin role-playing game: a hero is sent by a princess to retrieve an item.
x68000:157699.text: RPG doujin sederhana: seorang pahlawan diutus seorang putri untuk mengambil sebuah item.

x68000:157700.en: A comic visual novel about running a computer software company.
x68000:157700.text: Visual novel komedi tentang menjalankan perusahaan perangkat lunak komputer.

x68000:157701.en: The second Soft de Hard na Monogatari: the son who saved the family software company faces new trouble.
x68000:157701.text: Soft de Hard na Monogatari kedua: sang putra yang menyelamatkan perusahaan perangkat lunak keluarga menghadapi masalah baru.

x68000:157703.en: Two adventure games about high school memories, released together.
x68000:157703.text: Dua game petualangan tentang kenangan masa SMA, dirilis bersamaan.

x68000:157704.en: A first-person 3D space game mixing exploration, combat and role-playing as humanity meets alien civilizations in the 25th century.
x68000:157704.text: Game luar angkasa 3D sudut pandang orang pertama yang memadukan eksplorasi, pertempuran, dan bermain peran saat umat manusia bertemu peradaban alien di abad ke-25.

x68000:157705.en: Tehkan's vertical shooter: blast enemy craft and ground targets and collect letters for power-ups and bonuses.
x68000:157705.text: Penembak vertikal dari Tehkan: tembak pesawat musuh dan target darat serta kumpulkan huruf untuk power-up dan bonus.

x68000:157706.en: A puzzle game in which stars fall onto a large balance scale; keep it level by moving them before it tips.
x68000:157706.text: Teka-teki tempat bintang-bintang jatuh ke timbangan besar; jaga agar tetap seimbang dengan memindahkannya sebelum timbangan miring.

x68000:157707.en: Street Fighter II Champion Edition: all twelve fighters are playable, including the four bosses, and mirror matches are allowed.
x68000:157707.text: Street Fighter II Champion Edition: kedua belas petarung dapat dimainkan, termasuk keempat bos, dan pertandingan cermin diperbolehkan.

x68000:157708.en: A turn-based modern war strategy game in SystemSoft's Daisenryaku series, with many refinements to the Daisenryaku II rules.
x68000:157708.text: Game strategi perang modern berbasis giliran dalam seri Daisenryaku dari SystemSoft, dengan banyak penyempurnaan pada aturan Daisenryaku II.

x68000:157709.en: The fifth Dream Program System: three short, unrelated scenarios.
x68000:157709.text: Dream Program System kelima: tiga skenario pendek yang tidak berhubungan.

x68000:157710.en: Sega's motorcycle racer: ride across four continents, beating each section's time limit and using a turbo boost at top speed.
x68000:157710.text: Balap motor dari Sega: berkendara melintasi empat benua, mengalahkan batas waktu tiap bagian dan memakai turbo pada kecepatan puncak.

x68000:157711.en: A mahjong compilation of two arcade Super Real Mahjong games.
x68000:157711.text: Kompilasi mahjong dari dua game arkade Super Real Mahjong.

x68000:157712.en: An arcade mahjong game: a club member takes on its female players.
x68000:157712.text: Game mahjong arkade: seorang anggota klub menantang para pemain wanitanya.

x68000:157713.en: An adventure starring a photographer named Seisa.
x68000:157713.text: Petualangan dengan tokoh utama seorang fotografer bernama Seisa.

x68000:157714.en: Taito's shooter starring a segmented mechanical dragon: steer it through mazes, wrap its body around enemies and breathe fire.
x68000:157714.text: Penembak Taito dengan naga mekanik bersegmen: kemudikan melewati labirin, lilitkan tubuhnya mengitari musuh, dan semburkan api.

x68000:157715.en: Koei's strategy role-playing game: rise from a lowly retainer of Oda Nobunaga to unify Japan, as Toyotomi Hideyoshi did.
x68000:157715.text: RPG strategi dari Koei: naik dari pengikut rendahan Oda Nobunaga hingga menyatukan Jepang, seperti yang dilakukan Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

x68000:157716.en: A turn-based tactical game of defending a city and its power plant from giant monster attacks.
x68000:157716.text: Game taktik berbasis giliran tentang mempertahankan kota dan pembangkit listriknya dari serangan monster raksasa.

x68000:157718.en: SystemSoft's first feudal Japan strategy game: unify the country through conquest.
x68000:157718.text: Game strategi Jepang feodal pertama dari SystemSoft: satukan negeri melalui penaklukan.

x68000:157719.en: A role-playing game in which angels and demons dispute the fate of humanity.
x68000:157719.text: RPG tempat malaikat dan iblis memperebutkan nasib umat manusia.

x68000:157720.en: The block-stacking puzzle: rotate and drop pieces of four squares to complete and clear lines before the well fills.
x68000:157720.text: Teka-teki susun blok: putar dan jatuhkan kepingan empat persegi untuk melengkapi dan menghapus baris sebelum sumur penuh.

x68000:157721.en: A Columns-style puzzle: drop columns of fruit symbols and line up three of a kind to clear them.
x68000:157721.text: Teka-teki ala Columns: jatuhkan kolom simbol buah dan sejajarkan tiga yang sama untuk menghapusnya.

x68000:157722.en: Sega's helicopter shooter: fly the Gladiator gunship through overhead and behind-view stages to stop a coup.
x68000:157722.text: Penembak helikopter dari Sega: terbangkan helikopter tempur Gladiator melewati stage sudut pandang atas dan belakang untuk menghentikan kudeta.

x68000:157723.en: An Alice Soft role-playing game set in a city of gladiator tournaments, where a young fighter competes.
x68000:157723.text: RPG dari Alice Soft berlatar kota turnamen gladiator, tempat seorang petarung muda berkompetisi.

x68000:157724.en: A party role-playing game based on Tunnels & Trolls, set as an old peace between humans and monsters breaks down.
x68000:157724.text: RPG party berdasarkan Tunnels & Trolls, berlatar saat perdamaian lama antara manusia dan monster runtuh.

x68000:157725.en: An Alice Soft sci-fi adventure starring a space thief.
x68000:157725.text: Petualangan fiksi ilmiah dari Alice Soft dengan tokoh utama pencuri luar angkasa.

x68000:157726.en: The Avatar returns to Britannia, now at war with the gargoyles, and uncovers the truth behind the conflict in this open-world role-playing game.
x68000:157726.text: Avatar kembali ke Britannia, yang kini berperang dengan para gargoyle, dan mengungkap kebenaran di balik konflik itu dalam RPG dunia terbuka ini.

x68000:157727.en: A horror adventure based on the Urotsukidoji manga and anime.
x68000:157727.text: Petualangan horor berdasarkan manga dan anime Urotsukidoji.

x68000:157728.en: An isometric shooter in the tradition of Zaxxon, flying a ship through angled stages of mechanical enemies.
x68000:157728.text: Penembak isometrik dalam tradisi Zaxxon, menerbangkan pesawat melewati stage bersudut berisi musuh mekanis.

x68000:157729.en: The first Viper: three short animated stories.
x68000:157729.text: Viper pertama: tiga cerita beranimasi singkat.

x68000:157736.en: The second Viper: three short animated stories with minimal interaction.
x68000:157736.text: Viper kedua: tiga cerita beranimasi singkat dengan interaksi minimal.

x68000:157737.en: A cyberpunk adventure set in Tokyo in 2080.

x68000:157738.en: A visual novel in which a boy pursues the girl of his dreams.
x68000:157738.text: Visual novel tempat seorang anak laki-laki mengejar gadis impiannya.

x68000:157739.en: Koei's horse racing game: breed, train and race thoroughbreds, aiming to win the great races.
x68000:157739.text: Game balap kuda dari Koei: kembangbiakkan, latih, dan balapkan kuda pacu, dengan tujuan memenangkan balapan-balapan besar.

x68000:157740.en: A fantasy role-playing game set in a world balanced between a tribe of light and a tribe of shadow.
x68000:157740.text: RPG fantasi berlatar dunia yang seimbang antara suku cahaya dan suku bayangan.

x68000:157741.en: The Avatar travels to the Valley of Eodon, a land of dinosaurs and rival tribes, and must unite the tribes against an insectoid threat.
x68000:157741.text: Avatar pergi ke Lembah Eodon, negeri dinosaurus dan suku-suku saingan, dan harus menyatukan suku-suku melawan ancaman serangga.

x68000:157742.en: A turn-based wrestling game: manage a new women's wrestling company and its matches.
x68000:157742.text: Game gulat berbasis giliran: kelola perusahaan gulat wanita baru dan pertandingannya.

x68000:157743.en: A Wrestle Angels game in which you create your own wrestler.
x68000:157743.text: Game Wrestle Angels tempat Anda menciptakan pegulat sendiri.

x68000:157744.en: Micro Cabin's action role-playing sequel: Latok faces the demon Badu's return after rescuing a fellow warrior.
x68000:157744.text: Sekuel RPG aksi dari Micro Cabin: Latok menghadapi kembalinya iblis Badu setelah menyelamatkan sesama prajurit.

x68000:157745.en: Micro Cabin's action role-playing game: the young warrior Latok follows his missing father's path to stop the demon Badu.
x68000:157745.text: RPG aksi dari Micro Cabin: prajurit muda Latok mengikuti jejak ayahnya yang hilang untuk menghentikan iblis Badu.

x68000:157746.en: A fantasy role-playing game in which a young warrior serving human rulers fights the dark elves.
x68000:157746.text: RPG fantasi tempat seorang prajurit muda yang mengabdi pada penguasa manusia melawan elf gelap.

x68000:157747.en: A detective adventure: a sharp-eyed designer nicknamed the famous detective is drawn into a murder case.
x68000:157747.text: Petualangan detektif: seorang desainer berpandangan tajam yang dijuluki detektif terkenal terseret ke dalam kasus pembunuhan.

x68000:157748.en: The concluding Yami no Ketsuzoku: Miyu Izawa investigates a new series of murders in Tokyo.
x68000:157748.text: Penutup Yami no Ketsuzoku: Miyu Izawa menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan baru di Tokyo.

x68000:157749.en: A sci-fi role-playing game set in a far future when humanity has spread across the galaxy.
x68000:157749.text: RPG fiksi ilmiah berlatar masa depan jauh ketika umat manusia telah menyebar ke seluruh galaksi.

x68000:157750.en: A turn-based strategy game set in 2048, after biological weapons from a third world war created monsters.
x68000:157750.text: Game strategi berbasis giliran berlatar 2048, setelah senjata biologis dari perang dunia ketiga menciptakan monster.

x68000:157751.en: Falcom's side-view Ys: Adol and his friend Dogi travel to Dogi's home town of Redmont, where strange disturbances have begun.
x68000:157751.text: Ys tampak samping dari Falcom: Adol dan temannya Dogi pergi ke kampung halaman Dogi, Redmont, tempat gangguan aneh mulai terjadi.

x68000:157752.en: Wolf Team's strategy game of Japan's Warring States era, without the supernatural elements of the earlier Zan.
x68000:157752.text: Game strategi era Sengoku Jepang dari Wolf Team, tanpa unsur supernatural dari Zan sebelumnya.

x68000:157753.en: A role-playing game with a Western-style design: a hero sets out on a quest in a fantasy land.
x68000:157753.text: RPG dengan desain bergaya Barat: seorang pahlawan memulai misi di negeri fantasi.

x68000:159970.en: Origin's space game: fly, fight and trade across a star sector, joining factions and talking to characters on stations.
x68000:159970.text: Game luar angkasa dari Origin: terbang, bertarung, dan berdagang di sektor bintang, bergabung dengan faksi, dan berbicara dengan tokoh di stasiun.

x68000:163463.en: A doujin shooter begun in 1994 and finally released in 2014, now in the public domain.
x68000:163463.text: Penembak doujin yang mulai dibuat pada 1994 dan akhirnya dirilis pada 2014, kini berstatus domain publik.

x68000:177626.en: An adventure game by Crystal Soft, released in 1994.
x68000:177626.text: Game petualangan dari Crystal Soft, dirilis pada 1994.

x68000:180358.en: A shooter from Login Soft starring a transformable mecha.
x68000:180358.text: Penembak dari Login Soft dengan mecha yang dapat bertransformasi.

x68000:182381.en: A business simulation for up to four players: build a chain of hotels across Europe and outdo rival owners.
x68000:182381.text: Simulasi bisnis untuk hingga empat pemain: bangun jaringan hotel di seluruh Eropa dan kalahkan pemilik saingan.

x68000:183461.en: A doujin vertical shooter released by the circle Blue&White.
x68000:183461.text: Penembak vertikal doujin yang dirilis oleh lingkaran Blue&White.

x68000:183462.en: A top-down shooter: in the 21st century an unknown force attacks Tokyo, and a lone fighter takes it on.
x68000:183462.text: Penembak sudut pandang atas: di abad ke-21 kekuatan tak dikenal menyerang Tokyo, dan seorang pesawat tempur tunggal menghadapinya.

x68000:183466.en: A block-breaking game in the style of Arkanoid, with its own twist on how power-ups are earned.
x68000:183466.text: Game pemecah blok bergaya Arkanoid, dengan cara tersendiri dalam memperoleh power-up.

x68000:183467.en: A doujin vertical shooter by Mix.

x68000:183520.en: Technos's soccer game starring the Nekketsu dodgeball team, with rough, comic matches and special shots.
x68000:183520.text: Game sepak bola Technos dengan tim dodgeball Nekketsu, dengan pertandingan kasar dan lucu serta tendangan khusus.

x68000:184229.en: The classic sliding puzzle: move fifteen tiles around a four-by-four board to rebuild the picture.
x68000:184229.text: Teka-teki geser klasik: geser lima belas ubin di papan empat kali empat untuk menyusun kembali gambar.

x68000:184256.en: A short doujin bullet-hell shooter with two stages.
x68000:184256.text: Penembak bullet-hell doujin singkat dengan dua stage.

x68000:184277.en: The second Advanced Ruumik Quiz trivia game.
x68000:184277.text: Game trivia Advanced Ruumik Quiz kedua.

x68000:184278.en: An illustrated fantasy text adventure: explore an enchanted world to find thirteen treasures.
x68000:184278.text: Petualangan teks fantasi bergambar: jelajahi dunia yang terpesona untuk menemukan tiga belas harta karun.

x68000:184279.en: A single-player trivia quiz by Master Piece.
x68000:184279.text: Kuis trivia pemain tunggal oleh Master Piece.

x68000:184281.en: The second illustrated Adventure Land text adventure.
x68000:184281.text: Petualangan teks bergambar Adventure Land kedua.

x68000:184293.en: A doujin adventure parodying the Akazukin Chacha manga.
x68000:184293.text: Petualangan doujin yang memparodikan manga Akazukin Chacha.

x68000:184298.en: A doujin shooter with 3D-style effects, in which one button fires and the other turns the direction of fire.
x68000:184298.text: Penembak doujin dengan efek bergaya 3D, tempat satu tombol menembak dan tombol lainnya memutar arah tembakan.

x68000:184302.en: Wolf Team's first Arcus, a dungeon role-playing game: a party sets out against the dark forces threatening the magical kingdom of Arkases.

x68000:184321.en: The Dungeon Master sequel: lead four champions into Chaos's new dungeon, with tougher puzzles and monsters.
x68000:184321.text: Sekuel Dungeon Master: pimpin empat jagoan ke dungeon baru Chaos, dengan teka-teki dan monster yang lebih sulit.

x68000:184367.en: A doujin game about saving a tree by keeping its world in balance.

x68000:184368.en: A shooter set in the tunnels of asteroids, destroying alien defenses deep underground.
x68000:184368.text: Penembak berlatar terowongan asteroid, menghancurkan pertahanan alien jauh di bawah tanah.

x68000:184369.text: Versi buatan sendiri dari Asteroids: putar, dorong, dan tembak untuk memecah batu yang melayang.

x68000:184399.en: A rally racing game: keep off the track's edges and away from other racers to hold your speed.
x68000:184399.text: Game balap reli: jauhi tepi lintasan dan pembalap lain untuk mempertahankan kecepatan.

x68000:184400.en: A dice puzzle: match the dice that pop up, swapping the one in your hand.
x68000:184400.text: Teka-teki dadu: cocokkan dadu yang muncul dengan menukar dadu di tangan Anda.

x68000:184475.en: A party game of tossing a bomb at the other players before it goes off.
x68000:184475.text: Game pesta melempar bom ke pemain lain sebelum meledak.

x68000:184476.en: Flap through the air on two balloons and pop opponents' balloons from above while protecting your own.
x68000:184476.text: Melayanglah di udara dengan dua balon dan pecahkan balon lawan dari atas sambil melindungi balon sendiri.

x68000:184540.en: Namco's Baraduke: a space soldier explores alien caverns, shooting creatures and rescuing friendly Paccets.
x68000:184540.text: Baraduke dari Namco: seorang prajurit antariksa menjelajahi gua alien, menembaki makhluk dan menyelamatkan Paccet yang bersahabat.

x68000:184709.en: The second Might and Magic: a party of six travels the world of Cron, and through time, to save it from destruction.
x68000:184709.text: Might and Magic kedua: party enam orang melakukan perjalanan keliling dunia Cron, dan menembus waktu, untuk menyelamatkannya dari kehancuran.

x68000:184710.en: The first Might and Magic: a party of six explores the world of Varn in first-person, mapping dungeons and searching for the Inner Sanctum.
x68000:184710.text: Might and Magic pertama: party enam orang menjelajahi dunia Varn dalam sudut pandang orang pertama, memetakan dungeon dan mencari Inner Sanctum.

x68000:184711.en: An action role-playing game: a lone hero sets out to save the land of Hydlide from returning evil.
x68000:184711.text: RPG aksi: seorang pahlawan tunggal berangkat menyelamatkan negeri Hydlide dari kejahatan yang kembali.

x68000:184712.en: Taito's road racer in the style of Out Run: drive a sports car through traffic and beat the checkpoint times.
x68000:184712.text: Game balap jalan raya Taito bergaya Out Run: kemudikan mobil sport melewati lalu lintas dan kalahkan waktu di setiap pos pemeriksaan.

x68000:184715.en: An updated Xevious with new enemies and patterns: fly the Solvalou, shooting air targets and bombing ground installations.
x68000:184715.text: Xevious yang diperbarui dengan musuh dan pola baru: terbangkan Solvalou, tembak target udara dan bom instalasi darat.

x68000:184742.en: A role-playing game by Compac, released in 1990.

x68000:184743.en: Shogi, the Japanese chess game, against the computer.

x68000:184817.en: A solitaire card game played with a hanafuda flower deck.
x68000:184817.text: Game kartu solitaire yang dimainkan dengan dek bunga hanafuda.

x68000:184820.en: Namco's baseball game World Stadium, with Japanese professional teams.

x68000:184836.en: A rail shooter: fly through an enemy base, dodging obstacles and shooting defenders.
x68000:184836.text: Penembak rel: terbang menembus pangkalan musuh, menghindari rintangan dan menembak para pembela.

x68000:185635.en: A baseball management game: run a team as its manager.
x68000:185635.text: Game manajemen bisbol: kelola sebuah tim sebagai manajernya.

x68000:185643.en: Koei's strategy game set in 12th-century China: lead one of the outlaw heroes of the Water Margin and build a band strong enough to overthrow the corrupt minister Gao Qiu.
x68000:185643.text: Game strategi Koei berlatar Tiongkok abad ke-12: pimpin salah satu pahlawan buronan dari Water Margin dan bangun kelompok yang cukup kuat untuk menggulingkan menteri korup Gao Qiu.

x68000:185737.en: A naval strategy game of the war in the South Pacific, in a limited edition.

x68000:186750.text: If ketiga: skenario dengan lebih banyak pilihan dan konsekuensi yang lebih besar.

x68000:186751.text: Game golf 3D di lapangan 18 lubang yang dibangun dari lubang-lubang terkenal pilihan Jack Nicklaus.

x68000:186784.en: A mahjong game with a story mode set in a medieval fantasy world.

x68000:186785.text: Mahjong Gensoukyoku kedua: mahjong dengan mode cerita dan bermain bebas.

x68000:186788.en: A detective adventure in modern Japan: the young private investigator Ryu Kamishiro takes on new cases.
x68000:186788.text: Petualangan detektif di Jepang modern: detektif swasta muda Ryu Kamishiro menangani kasus-kasus baru.

x68000:186866.en: The fifth Nobunaga's Ambition: unify 16th-century Japan as a daimyo, now ranked by fame and hegemony as well as land.
x68000:186866.text: Nobunaga's Ambition kelima: satukan Jepang abad ke-16 sebagai daimyo, kini dinilai berdasarkan ketenaran dan hegemoni selain wilayah.

x68000:186869.en: Koei's strategy game of Japan's Warring States era: as a daimyo, manage your provinces' rice, troops and loyalty and conquer the country.
x68000:186869.text: Game strategi era Sengoku Jepang dari Koei: sebagai daimyo, kelola beras, pasukan, dan kesetiaan provinsi Anda lalu taklukkan negeri.

x68000:186870.en: The second Nobunaga's Ambition: conquer 16th-century Japan with more provinces, generals and options than the first.
x68000:186870.text: Nobunaga's Ambition kedua: taklukkan Jepang abad ke-16 dengan lebih banyak provinsi, jenderal, dan pilihan dibanding yang pertama.

x68000:186873.en: The fourth Nobunaga's Ambition: rule a clan of the Warring States era, using tea ceremonies, technology and generals to conquer Japan.
x68000:186873.text: Nobunaga's Ambition keempat: pimpin sebuah klan era Sengoku, memakai upacara minum teh, teknologi, dan para jenderal untuk menaklukkan Jepang.

x68000:186875.en: Koei's Pacific War strategy game: command the Japanese or Allied navy, managing fleets, production and bases.
x68000:186875.text: Game strategi Perang Pasifik dari Koei: pimpin angkatan laut Jepang atau Sekutu, mengelola armada, produksi, dan pangkalan.

x68000:186877.en: A Populous data disk adding five new landscape types, from the Wild West to the French Revolution.
x68000:186877.text: Disk data Populous yang menambahkan lima jenis lanskap baru, dari Wild West hingga Revolusi Prancis.

x68000:186878.en: A top-down motorcycle rally game from San Francisco to New York: race rival bikers, manage fuel and avoid crashes.

x68000:186919.en: Koei's strategy game of the fall of the Qin dynasty: lead Liu Bang or Xiang Yu in the struggle to found a new empire.

x68000:186920.en: An animated driving game: steer and react to on-screen prompts as you race through a revenge story drawn as anime.

x68000:186933.en: The second Romance of the Three Kingdoms, with more officers, scenarios and diplomatic options.
x68000:186933.text: Romance of the Three Kingdoms kedua, dengan lebih banyak perwira, skenario, dan pilihan diplomatik.

x68000:186934.en: The third Romance of the Three Kingdoms: lead a warlord's officers in war, administration and diplomacy to unite China.

x68000:187005.en: Mahjong solitaire with the Dragon's Eye variant, where one player builds the layout and the other clears it.

x68000:187017.en: A puzzle game in the style of Sokoban: push oversized mahjong tiles to clear a path to the goal.

x68000:187019.en: A raising simulation: as a high school teacher, guide five troubled girls through their final school year.

x68000:187020.en: An isometric puzzle-action game: steer the spinning probe Gerald around floating worlds, collecting jewels before your fuel runs out.
x68000:187020.text: Game teka-teki aksi isometrik: kemudikan probe berputar Gerald mengelilingi dunia melayang, mengumpulkan permata sebelum bahan bakar habis.

x68000:187022.en: Origin's role-playing game: instead of slaying a villain, become the Avatar by mastering the eight virtues across Britannia.
